expected_tasks.source_quote: Contact Example Community Clinic to arrange a follow-up appointment in 7–10 days. If you already have an appointment, confirm the date and time with the clinic.
If you were referred to a specialist during your visit, check the referral paperwork for the clinic's contact details and next steps.
Keep the wrist support in place as directed by the clinician who treated you. If you are unsure how long to use it, contact the clinic for clarification.
Avoid activities that worsen your discomfort until you have received further guidance from your treating clinician.
Seek urgent medical assessment if you develop new numbness, fingers that become pale or blue, rapidly increasing swelling, severe or worsening pain, or any other symptom that concerns you.
For an emergency, contact local emergency services.
